# Viliha Web Services

> Viliha Web Services is a remote software development company. It builds custom software, web and mobile applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure for startups, AI companies and enterprises, and it supplies dedicated development teams. Clients are served remotely in the USA, UK, Europe, Germany, Australia and Singapore. To start a project, use the contact form at https://viliha.com/contact or email getintouch@viliha.com.

Key facts, each one stated on viliha.com:
- Services: custom software, responsive web development, iOS and Android apps, UX/UI design, API development and integration, cloud and DevOps, QA and testing, e-commerce and enterprise systems, dedicated teams, ongoing support and maintenance, and SEO.
- Technologies: React, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Python, .NET, Go, Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter, MySQL and PostgreSQL, deployed on AWS, Azure, GCP or DigitalOcean.
- Engagement models: a full-time dedicated team, team augmentation, project-based teams, or managed services.
- Support plans: business hours, extended hours, or 24/7 enterprise support.

What this site does not state:
- It publishes no prices or hourly rates. Every engagement starts with a free consultation.
- It names no clients and publishes no case-study metrics.

## Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://viliha.com/services/custom-software-development): bespoke business software, legacy replacement, and integrations.
- [Responsive Web Development](https://viliha.com/services/web-development): full-stack web applications, CMS, portals, and payment integration.
- [Mobile App Development](https://viliha.com/services/mobile-app-development): native iOS and Android apps, plus cross-platform apps in React Native or Flutter.
- [UX/UI Design](https://viliha.com/services/ux-ui-design): user research, wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.
- [API Development & Integration](https://viliha.com/services/api-development): REST and GraphQL APIs, and third-party integrations.
- [Cloud Solutions](https://viliha.com/services/cloud-solutions): migration, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, and serverless.
- [QA & Testing](https://viliha.com/services/qa-and-testing): manual, automated, performance, and security testing.
- [Dedicated Development Teams](https://viliha.com/services/dedicated-development-teams): staff augmentation and dedicated engineering teams.
- [E-commerce & Enterprise Solutions](https://viliha.com/services/ecommerce-solutions): Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, ERP, and CRM.
- [Ongoing Support & Maintenance](https://viliha.com/services/ongoing-support): monitoring, fixes, security updates, and feature work.
- [SEO Services](https://viliha.com/services/seo): technical audits, on-page optimization, and local SEO.
- [All services](https://viliha.com/services): overview of every service.

## Regions
- [USA](https://viliha.com/software-development/usa): working hours overlap with EST and PST.
- [United Kingdom](https://viliha.com/software-development/uk): working hours overlap with UK business hours.
- [Europe](https://viliha.com/software-development/europe): working hours overlap with CET; GDPR is considered from the start of development.
- [Germany](https://viliha.com/software-development/germany): serves German SMEs and Mittelstand companies.
- [Australia](https://viliha.com/software-development/australia): working hours align with AEST/AEDT.
- [Singapore](https://viliha.com/software-development/singapore): delivered by Vietnam-based teams (UTC+7, one hour behind Singapore).
